texts: good. the postural "lie" is recorded as a position rather than an invented event, "under" keeps its own surface preposition instead of being flattened into containment, and "in the Sunken Cove" is carried on the water it modifies. The bones' position attaches to each bone through a fireable rule rather than to the group as a whole, which is the only soft spot and costs no content, so no rewrite is needed.
